mixed: Mixed review: praise and criticism of parts, overall verdict lost
plot: Plot/content description dominates (sentiment words describe the story)
nonfilm: Sentiment aimed at a non-film target (real person, TV channel, other reviewer, extra)
contrast: Contrast turn: long praise, then negative verdict ('Well, bad.', 'However')
sobad: 'So bad it's good': negative words used as praise
hedged: Hedged / understated sentiment, few polar words
contradicts: Text contradicts gold label (likely borderline rating or label noise)
negation: Negation ('a good horror flick this is not')
